scientific_integrity: The assertion is derived by a written combinatorial bijection and formal exponential formula. Independent BFS and exhaustive exact-cover tests for 2<=n<=7 corroborate but do not prove the full theorem.
scientific_limitations: The three-row result concerns maximum-cardinality geodesic packings, not all maximal packings or arbitrary row counts. OEIS A137946 already gives the exact coefficient triangle and its equivalent generating function; the scientific claim of additional originality is restricted to the rook-graph maximal-geodesic packing bijection and exact graph-invariant interpretation. Unknown equivalent tiling/path-decomposition literature could predate this interpretation. Independent audit has not occurred.
title: Perfect geodesic packings of three-row rook graphs and their cycle-index polynomial
